import json
from scipy.special import erf
f=np.load('base_feats.npz'); y=f['y']
def gelu(x): return 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))
def LN(x): 
    m=x.mean(1,keepdims=True); v=x.var(1,keepdims=True); return (x-m)/np.sqrt(v+1e-12)
k=np.load('kernel_v2.npz'); U=np.load('U_v2.npy')
A=json.load(open('my_sents_all.json')); ym=np.array(A['labels'])
Xp=LN(f['cls11'].astype(np.float64)+2*f['mean11'])
Xm=LN(np.load('pass_10/cls_hidden_L11.npy').astype(np.float64)+2*np.load('pass_10/mean_hidden_L11.npy'))
mu=k['mu']; sd=k['sd']
print('mu/sd match', np.abs(mu-Xp.mean(0)).max(), np.abs(sd-(Xp.std(0)+1e-6)).max(), np.abs(k['n']-Xp).max())
Zp=(Xp-mu)/sd; Zm=(Xm-mu)/sd; d=768
C=np.vstack([Zp,Zm]); yc=np.concatenate([y,ym]); w=np.concatenate([np.ones(len(y)),0.3*np.ones(len(ym))])
lam=0.005
P=gelu(C@C.T/d); T=np.eye(8)[yc]; ws=w/w.sum(); Pm=ws@P; Tm=ws@T; Pc=P-Pm
Aw=np.linalg.solve(Pc.T@(Pc*w[:,None])+lam*np.eye(len(Pc)), Pc.T@((T-Tm)*w[:,None]))
b0=Tm-Pm@Aw
F=P@Aw+b0
print('train acc practice', (np.argmax(F[:1496],1)==y).mean(), 'mine', (np.argmax(F[1496:],1)==ym).mean())
print('|A| max', np.abs(Aw).max(), 'v2 |Wf| max', np.abs(k['Wf']).max())
S=100.
nbar=Xp.mean(0)
def expected_logits(Xn, Fv):
    x=Xn + (S*Fv - (U.T@nbar))@U.T
    ln=(x-x.mean(1,keepdims=True))/np.sqrt(x.var(1,keepdims=True)+1e-12)
    return 10*np.tanh(0.05*ln@U)
Ep=expected_logits(Xp,F[:1496]); Em=expected_logits(Xm,F[1496:])
print('expected acc', (Ep.argmax(1)==y).mean(), (Em.argmax(1)==ym).mean())
# float32 sensitivity of FFN
W1=(C/sd/d).astype(np.float32); b1=(-(C/sd/d)@mu).astype(np.float32)
W2=(S*U@Aw.T).astype(np.float32); b2=(U@(S*b0-U.T@nbar)).astype(np.float32)
h=gelu((Xp.astype(np.float32)@W1.T+b1).astype(np.float64)).astype(np.float32)
o32=(h@W2.T+b2).astype(np.float64)
o64=(S*F[:1496]-U.T@nbar)@U.T
print('float32 err in FFN out (proj on U)/S', np.abs((o32-o64)@U).max()/S)
np.savez('kernel_v3.npz', mu=mu, sd=sd, C=C, yc=yc, w=w, lam=lam, A=Aw, b0=b0, F=F, nbar=nbar)
np.save('v3_expected_logits_practice.npy', Ep); np.save('v3_expected_logits_mine.npy', Em)
